source.name: DESIGN.md collection (awesome-design-md)
source.license: List from VoltAgent/awesome-design-md (MIT); descriptions quoted from the list. Each DESIGN.md is an analysis of a public website's look; brand names belong to their owners.
source.note: DESIGN.md is a plain-text design-system file format introduced by Google Stitch for AI agents. metrics.stars = stars of the list repository (same for every row).
